nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balance storing token balances of every holder
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances storing ERC20 allowances
mapping(address=>bool) private _isExcludedFromFee flagging fee-exempt accounts
uint256 private _tTotal total token supply (TOTAL_SUPPLY * 10**DECIMALS)
uint256 private _taxFee tax percentage applied on transfers
address payable private _taxWallet receiving collected ETH tax, set to msg.sender in constructor
uint256 private _maxTxAmount maximum buy amount enforced on swaps from the pair
IUniswapV2Router02 private _uniswap router instance used for swaps, liquidity and pair creation
address private _pair address of the created Uniswap trading pair
bool private _canTrade flag gating pair creation
bool private _inSwap reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier
bool private _swapEnabled enables automatic contract-token swaps on transfer
address private _owner owner set in Ownable constructor from _msgSender()
TengenInu constructor: sets _taxWallet to msg.sender, _taxFee, router, initial balances, max tx amount and emits Transfer
public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer
public transferFrom performing allowance subtraction and calling _transfer
public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) calling _approve with _msgSender()
private _approve writing the _allowances mapping and emitting Approval
private _transfer core logic: checks, external O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount gate, buy limit, automatic swap/send ETH and fee computation
private _tokenTransfer computing tax with SafeMath mul/div/sub/add and updating _balance entries
private swapTokensForEth guarded by lockTheSwap; builds path, approves router and swaps tokens for ETH
private sendETHToFee transferring ETH balance to _taxWallet
addToWhitelist(address buyer) onlyTaxCollector setting _isExcludedFromFee true
removeFromWhitelist(address buyer) onlyTaxCollector setting _isExcludedFromFee false
lowerTax(uint256 newTaxRate) onlyTaxCollector updating _taxFee below INITIAL_TAX
removeBuyLimit() onlyTaxCollector setting _maxTxAmount to _tTotal
createUniswapPair() onlyTaxCollector approving router and creating the pair via factory
addLiquidity() onlyTaxCollector adding liquidity with contract ETH and enabling trading
swapForTax() onlyTaxCollector swapping the whole contract token balance to ETH
collectTax() onlyTaxCollector sending the contract ETH balance to the tax wallet
public view balanceOf(address account) returning _balance[account]
Ownable renounceOwnership() onlyOwner setting _owner to address(0)
Ownable owner() view returning _owner
Context _msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender
msg.sender untrusted caller address used in _msgSender, constructor, transfer, approve and access modifiers
block.timestamp used as swap and liquidity deadline, miner-manipulable
external staticcall O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount(address(this)) executed inside _transfer as a hidden transfer gate
external call _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens transferring tokens out and sending ETH back
external ETH transfer via _taxWallet.transfer(amount) in sendETHToFee
external swap invocation with user-influenced tokenAmount and block.timestamp deadline inside swapTokensForEth
external addLiquidityETH call spending the whole contract ETH balance with block.timestamp deadline
external factory createPair call plus IERC20(_pair).approve(type(uint).max) in createUniswapPair
arithmetic operations mul/div/sub/add in _tokenTransfer computing tTeam and tTransferAmount
arithmetic subtraction of allowance in transferFrom
parameter from of private _transfer
parameter to of private _transfer
parameter amount of private _transfer
local address[] memory path built in swapTokensForEth
local uint256 contractTokenBalance read in _transfer before swapping
parameter newTaxRate of lowerTax
parameter buyer of addToWhitelist

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument to _transfer through transfer()
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer function
_transfer indirectly mutates _balance through _tokenTransfer
msg.sender is used as owner argument in approve()
approve() calls the internal _approve helper
constructor sets _owner to msg.sender, the privileged owner account
constructor assigns _taxWallet = payable(msg.sender), the privileged tax collector
onlyTaxCollector compares _taxWallet with msg.sender in addToWhitelist
onlyTaxCollector compares _taxWallet with msg.sender in removeFromWhitelist
lowerTax is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
removeBuyLimit is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
createUniswapPair is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
addLiquidity is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
swapForTax is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
collectTax is restricted to the tax collector derived from msg.sender
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer to move balances
_taxFee is passed as taxRate into _tokenTransfer for fee computation
_maxTxAmount bounds the buy amount inside _transfer
_swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer
_inSwap guard is checked before performing the swap in _transfer
lockTheSwap modifier sets _inSwap = true while swapTokensForEth performs its external call
_transfer performs the external swap through swapTokensForEth before balances are updated in _tokenTransfer
_uniswap router instance is used for WETH and swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
_uniswap.factory() and WETH() are used to create the pair in createUniswapPair
createUniswapPair assigns the factory returned address to _pair
createUniswapPair executes the external createPair and unlimited approve calls
addLiquidity forwards contract ETH to the external addLiquidityETH call
swapTokensForEth triggers the external swap operation that moves tokens out of the contract
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to _taxWallet
_taxWallet is the destination of the ETH sent in sendETHToFee
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds TAX_THRESHOLD
the router swap callback can re-enter _transfer while the contract still holds tokens and ETH
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent
the external O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount(address(this)) call acts as a hidden transfer gate inside _transfer and depends on an attacker-influenced contract
_tokenTransfer performs mul/div/sub/add arithmetic on transfer amounts
transferFrom subtracts the amount from the stored allowance
_tokenTransfer writes the sender, recipient and contract entries of _balance
_approve writes the _allowances mapping and emits Approval
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract token balance
collectTax calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0)
_transfer compares from/to against owner() to decide fee and swap handling
_isExcludedFromFee lookups control fee exemption inside _transfer
lowerTax writes a new value into _taxFee used in fee arithmetic
the from parameter drives the checks and balance updates in _transfer
the to parameter drives pair/owner checks and balance updates in _transfer
the amount parameter drives the limit checks and fee computation in _transfer
the local path array is supplied to the external swap call
the local contractTokenBalance is passed to swapTokensForEth

normalization_plan.reason: the from parameter has no standalone security meaning; it feeds the checks and state updates of _transfer
the to parameter only parameterizes the pair/owner checks inside _transfer
the amount parameter is only consumed by the limit and fee logic of _transfer
the ephemeral path array exists solely to invoke the router swap in swapTokensForEth
contractTokenBalance is a temporary snapshot used only by the swap branch of _transfer
newTaxRate only parameterizes the guarded _taxFee update performed by lowerTax
buyer only parameterizes the _isExcludedFromFee write performed by addToWhitelist
